goals.name: 在当前列表中切换相邻线程

Amend existing FSC-0411 name from previous-thread-only to adjacent-thread navigation and add one forward operation; preserve its prior backward operation/scenarios. Target order and onSelect remain injected.
conditions: Same mounted registration/isActive/priority, target list/current id, keymap and captured command context as prior JQa contract.
failureAndCancellation: Empty list, invalid current id and last target must not invent wrap. Actual navigation and preference writes are unobserved.
knownGaps: Injected targets/onSelect and command winner, real route selection, tab interception and shortcut preference durability.
deduplication: Same complete JQa callback owns nextThread and previousThread with direction parameter; extend FSC-0411 instead of inventing another feature for direction or alternate binding.
